description: SP Energy Networks, the distribution operator for central and southern Scotland (SPD) and Merseyside and North Wales (SPM), publishes 162 datasets on an Opendatasoft portal, read on 2026-09-26, with an open data licence, a shared data licence, a data triage process and API documentation. Datasets read include the SPD Distribution Future Energy Scenarios totals by substation, giving forecasts by technology, scenario and year for primary substations and 88 grid supply points (about 554,000 rows), and a weekly substation carbon estimate of CO2-equivalent intensity at most primary substations and grid supply points in both licence areas, updated to 25 September 2026. Long Term Development Statement Stage 2 models for SPD and SPM are published in the Common Information Model with existing and future network cases; access to the CIM section needs a request through an online form and acceptance of the shared data licence. Open datasets are free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: DFES values are scenarios, and single-customer sites are excluded. Simulation uses are network flow models built from CIM files and capacity planning under future scenarios. Related records: data-uk-power-networks-open-data-portal publishes LTDS CIM for its areas.
licence: CC-BY-4.0 for open datasets; CIM models under the SP Energy Networks Shared Data Licence
